paragraphs: DXC Technology is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations - helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates.

DXC serves a global client base, including many Fortune 500 companies, supported by approximately 115,000 employees in 60 countries. We operate through three reportable segments that align with how management assesses performance of the business and allocates resources - Consulting & Engineering Services ("CES"), Global Infrastructure Services ("GIS"), and Insurance Software & Services ("Insurance") - delivering solutions that modernize operations and drive innovation across our customers' entire IT estate.

Across these segments, we embed AI, automation and data-driven capabilities into our services and solutions to improve efficiency, enhance operations and support better business outcomes for clients. Our approach is anchored in our proprietary Xponential framework, which integrates governance, automation and human expertise to help clients transition from pilot use cases to scaled, production-level deployment in a responsible and controlled manner.

In addition, we have established a Core Track and Fast Track approach to guide the evolution of our portfolio. Core Track enhances our existing offerings through AI and automation to improve efficiency, strengthen competitiveness and bring our portfolio to its full potential. Fast Track develops AI-native and highly AI-infused solutions to address evolving client needs and expand opportunities across our segments.

•Consulting & Engineering Services – Helps businesses use AI and data analytics to improve operations, automate tasks, and speed up their digital transformation. We provide software engineering, consulting, and custom and enterprise applications solutions that help companies manage essential functions, modernize processes, and drive innovation. We have strong expertise in industries like finance, automotive, manufacturing, healthcare, life sciences, travel, and the public sector. Our solutions help businesses stay competitive by improving efficiency, launching new products faster, expanding into new markets, and achieving their strategic goals.

•Global Infrastructure Services – Implements and operates the technology underpinning the critical systems of global businesses and governments. Clients trust us to secure, modernize, and operate their critical systems and improve workplace experience to support business growth. Services include the design, migration, and management of complex data center, mainframe, cloud, and network environments, with an emphasis on scalability, security, compliance, and cost efficiency. By leveraging a human-led, AI-driven Intelligent Operations approach, we deliver secure, reliable IT operations that clients trust. We also provide cross-industry business process services, which streamline clients' core enterprise functions such as finance, HR, procurement, and customer service. The implementation of secure, reliable technology improves employee experiences and productivity by streamlining daily operations—such as device management, helpdesk support, and AI-powered automation—enabling seamless collaboration, reducing IT support demands, and lowering costs through intuitive, self-service tools.

•Insurance Software & Services – Provides software and services for Life and Wealth, Property & Casualty and Reinsurance providers, helping them optimize, run and digitally transform their operations. We help insurers modernize their technology landscape from heritage systems to advanced AI-powered solutions that enhance operational efficiency, improve customer experiences, and enable insurers to adopt a digital-first approach. Complementing our software solutions, we provide comprehensive business process services, leveraging deep industry expertise to support the full spectrum of insurance operations.

See Note 19 - "Segment and Geographic Information" for additional information related to our reportable segments, including the disclosure of segment revenues, segment profit, and financial information by geographic area.
DXC was formed on April 1, 2017 by the merger of CSC and HPES (the "HPES Merger").
During the past three fiscal years, we completed the sale of various insignificant businesses. See Note 2 - "Divestitures" for further information.

We market and sell our services to customers through a global direct sales force, operating across multiple locations around the world. Our customers include commercial businesses of various sizes and industries, as well as public sector enterprises. No individual customer exceeded 10% of our consolidated revenues for fiscal 2026, fiscal 2025, or fiscal 2024.

Our business results may vary from period to period with overall demand for our services impacted by factors such as customer budget cycles, industry-specific trends, and year-end project activity. While these seasonal variations do not materially affect our long-term performance, they may contribute to periodic fluctuations in revenue, expenses, and profitability. We continue to monitor these trends and adjust our operations as needed to optimize performance throughout the year.

The IT and professional services markets we compete in are highly competitive, with a large number of companies having onshore and offshore delivery capabilities offering services that overlap with our offerings.
•large multinational enterprises that offer some or all of the services and solutions that we offer;

headings: Risks Related to Our Completed Strategic Transactions
We may fail to develop and expand our service offerings to address emerging business demands and technological trends and remain competitive.
Our ability to provide customers with competitive services is dependent on our ability to attract and retain qualified personnel.

Risks associated with artificial intelligence, including our adoption, deployment, and governance of AI technologies, could adversely affect our business, reputation, financial condition, and results of operations.

Systems failures, catastrophic events, and resulting interruptions in the availability of our products or services could harm our business, damage our reputation, and subject us to substantial liability.

Failure to maintain our credit rating, manage our indebtedness, and raise additional capital for future needs could adversely affect our liquidity, capital position, borrowing cost, and access to capital markets.
We are exposed to risks inherent to our international operations, including fluctuations in exchange rates, and geopolitical conflicts and disruptions can adversely affect our sales and operations.
Prolonged periods of inflation and related economic conditions could adversely affect our profitability, results of operations, and cash flow.
paragraphs: Our operations and financial results are subject to various risks and uncertainties. Any of the following risks could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, or prospects, and the actual outcome of matters as to which forward-looking statements are made in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. In such case, the trading price for DXC common stock could decline, and you could lose all or part of your investment. Past performance may not be a reliable indicator of future financial performance and historical trends should not be used to anticipate results or trends in future periods. Future performance and historical trends may be adversely affected by the risks discussed in this section. Other variables and risks and uncertainties not currently known or that are currently expected to be immaterial may also have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, or prospects, or on the price of shares of our common stock in the future.
•If we do not effectively manage and improve our sales organization, we may have difficulty acquiring new customers or increasing sales to existing customers.
•We may fail to develop and expand service offerings to address emerging demands and technological trends and remain competitive.
•Our ability to provide customers with competitive services is dependent on our ability to attract and retain qualified personnel.
•Risks associated with artificial intelligence, including our adoption, deployment, and governance of AI technologies, could adversely affect our business.

•If we are unable to accurately estimate the cost of services and the timeline for completion of contracts, or if we or third parties fail to deliver on commitments to our customers, the profitability of our contracts may be adversely affected.

paragraphs: The purpose of the Management's Discussion and Analysis ("MD&A") is to present information that management believes is relevant to an assessment and understanding of our results of operations and cash flows for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 and our financial condition as of March 31, 2026. The MD&A is provided as a supplement to, and should be read in conjunction with, our financial statements and notes.
The MD&A is organized in the following sections: •Background •Results of Operations •Liquidity and Capital Resources

The following discussion includes a comparison of our results of operations and liquidity and capital resources for fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2025. A comparison of our results of operations and liquidity and capital resources for fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2024 may be found in "Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" on Form 10-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on May 15, 2025.

DXC is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates.

We generate revenue by offering a wide range of information technology services and solutions primarily in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. Effective April 1, 2025 (fiscal year 2026), we began reporting our financial results under a new segment structure designed to better reflect the Company's operational structure and the delivery of end-to-end IT services. The new structure includes three reportable segments: Consulting & Engineering Services ("CES"), Global Infrastructure Services ("GIS"), and Insurance Software & Services ("Insurance").

Key revenue, profitability and cash flow metrics for fiscal 2026 compared to fiscal 2025 are included below. We have presented organic revenue, adjusted earnings before income taxes, and adjusted diluted earnings per share on a non-GAAP basis. For more information see "Non-GAAP Financial Measures."
•Revenues of $12.64 billion, down 1.8% year-over-year (down 4.8% on an organic basis);
•EBIT was $353 million with a corresponding margin of 2.8%. Adjusted EBIT was $970 million, down 4.8% year-over-year with a corresponding margin of 7.7%;
•Diluted earnings per share of $0.10, compared to $2.10 in fiscal 2025; adjusted diluted earnings per share of $3.23, compared to $3.43 in fiscal 2025;
•Cash generated from operations was $1,248 million, less capital expenditures of $535 million, resulted in free cash flow of $713 million, compared to free cash flow of $687 million in the prior-year
•Book-to-bill ratio (contract awards divided by annual revenue) of 0.98x, compared to 1.03x during fiscal 2025.
•Revenue was $5,023 million, down 0.8% year-over-year (down 3.8% on an organic basis).
•Segment profit was $518 million, down 10.7% year-over-year, with a corresponding margin of 10.3%.
•Book-to-bill ratio of 1.10x, compared to 1.08x during fiscal 2025. Global Infrastructure Services

paragraphs: DXC Technology 是一家領先的企業科技與創新夥伴，提供軟體、服務與解決方案給全球企業與公部門機構 - 幫助他們運用 AI 在總體經濟快速變化的時期，以速度驅動成果。憑藉在 Managed Infrastructure Services、Application Modernization 和 Industry-Specific Software Solutions 方面的深厚專業知識，DXC 現代化、安全並運作一些世界上最複雜的科技設施。

DXC 服務全球客戶羣，包括許多《財富》500 大企業，並在 60 個國家擁有約 115,000 名員工。我們透過三個應報告分部運作，這些分部與管理層評估業務表現及分配資源的方式一致 - Consulting & Engineering Services（"CES"）、Global Infrastructure Services（"GIS"）以及 Insurance Software & Services（"Insurance"）- 提供解決方案以現代化客戶的整體 IT 設施並驅動創新。
在這些分部中，我們將 AI、自動化與數據驅動的能力嵌入服務與解決方案中，以提高效率、增強運作並支持客戶更好的業務成果。我們的作法以專屬的 Xponential 框架為基礎，整合治理、自動化與人際專業知識，協助客戶從試點案例轉型為可擴展、生產級的部署，並以負責任且受控的方式進行。
此外，我們已建立 Core Track 與 Fast Track 的方法，以引導我們產品組合的演進。Core Track 透過 AI 與自動化增強我們現有的產品，以提高效率、強化競爭力並讓產品組合發揮最大潛力。Fast Track 開發 AI 原生且高度 AI 融入的解決方案，以應對客戶需求的變化並拓展各分部的機會。

•Consulting & Engineering Services – 幫助企業運用 AI 與數據分析改善運作、自動化任務並加速其數位轉型。我們提供軟體工程、諮詢與客製化及企業應用程式解決方案，協助公司管理必要功能、現代化流程並驅動創新。我們在金融、汽車、製造、醫療、生命科學、旅遊及公部門等產業有強大的專業知識。我們的解決方案幫助企業保持競爭力，透過提高效率、更快推出新產品、拓展新市場並實現戰略目標。

•Global Infrastructure Services – 落實並運作全球企業與政府關鍵系統的科技基礎設施。客戶信任我們來確保安全、現代化並運作其關鍵系統，並改善工作場所體驗以支持業務成長。服務包括設計、遷移與管理複雜的資料中心、大型主機、雲端與網路環境，強調可擴展性、安全性、合規性與成本效益。透過結合人為領導與 AI 驅動的 Intelligent Operations 方法，我們提供客戶信任的安全、可靠 IT 運作。我們也提供跨產業的業務流程服務，以簡化客戶的核心企業功能，如財務、人力資源、採購與客戶服務。實施安全、可靠的科技可改善員工體驗與生產力，透過簡化日常運作 - 如裝置管理、客服支援與 AI 優化自動化 - 促進順暢協作，減少 IT 支援需求，並透過直覺、自服務工具降低成本。

•Insurance Software & Services – 提供軟體與服務給 Life and Wealth、Property & Casualty 與 Reinsurance 提供者，協助他們優化、運作並數位轉型其業務。我們協助保險公司從傳統系統現代化其科技架構至先進的 AI 驅動解決方案，以提升運作效率、改善客戶體驗，並讓保險公司採用數位為先的策略。除了我們的軟體解決方案，我們也提供全面的業務流程服務，運用深厚的產業專業知識，支持保險業務的完整範疇。
請參閱附註 19 - "Segment 和地理資訊"，以取得與我們應報告分部相關的額外資訊，包括分部收入、分部利潤及按地理區域披露的財務資訊。
DXC 於 2017 年 4 月 1 日由 CSC 與 HPES（"HPES Merger"）合併成立。
過去三個會計年度，我們完成了多項無足輕重業務的出售。有關進一步資訊，請參閱附註 2 - "Divestitures"。
我們透過全球直接銷售團隊行銷並銷售服務，營運範圍遍及世界各地多個地點。我們的客戶包括各類規模與產業的商業企業，以及公共部門機構。在 2026 年會計年度、2025 年會計年度或 2024 年會計年度，沒有任何單一客戶超過我們合併營業收入的 10%。
我們的營運成果可能因期別而異，整體服務需求受客戶預算週期、產業特定趨勢及年底專案活動等因素影響。雖然這些季節性變動不會顯著影響我們的長期表現，但可能會導致營收、費用及獲利的週期性波動。我們持續監測這些趨勢，並根據需要調整營運，以全年最佳化表現。
我們所競爭的資訊科技與專業服務市場競爭激烈，有許多公司具備在岸與離岸交付能力，所提供的服務與我們的服務重疊。
•大型跨國企業，提供部分或全部我們所提供的服務與解決方案；

paragraphs: 管理層討論與分析（"MD&A"）的目的在於提供管理層認為與評估及瞭解本公司於財務年度截至2026年3月31日之營運成果與現金流，以及截至2026年3月31日之財務狀況相關之資訊。MD&A為財務報表與附註之補充資料，應與財務報表與附註一併閱讀。
MD&A之內容分為以下幾個部分：•背景 •營運成果 •流動性與資本運用
以下討論包含本公司於財務年度2026與財務年度2025之營運成果與流動性與資本運用之比較。本公司於財務年度2025與財務年度2024之營運成果與流動性與資本運用之比較，請參閱於2025年5月15日提交至證券交易委員會之Form 10-K申報文件中之"第7項 管理層討論與分析財務狀況與營運成果"。
DXC為全球企業與公部門組織提供軟體、服務與解決方案的領導企業科技與創新夥伴，在指數級變革的時代，協助客戶以速度驅動成果，善用AI。憑藉在受管理基礎設施服務、應用程式現代化與產業特定軟體解決方案方面的深厚專業，DXC現代化、強化安全性並運作世界上一些最複雜的科技設施。
本公司透過提供廣泛的資訊科技服務與解決方案，主要在北美、歐洲、亞洲與澳洲地區產生營業收入。自2025年4月1日起（財務年度2026），本公司開始根據新的分部結構報告財務成果，此結構設計用以更準確反映本公司之營運結構與端到端資訊科技服務之交付。新的結構包含三個應報告分部：諮詢與工程服務（"CES"）、全球基礎設施服務（"GIS"）與保險軟體與服務（"Insurance"）。

headings: 與本公司業務相關的風險
與本公司已完成之戰略交易相關的風險
本公司可能無法開發並擴展服務方案以應對新興業務需求及科技趨勢，並保持競爭力。
本公司提供客戶具有競爭力之服務的能力，取決於本公司吸引並留住合格人員之能力。
與人工智慧相關之風險，包括本公司對人工智慧技術之採用、部署及治理，可能對本公司業務、聲譽、財務狀況及營運結果造成不利影響。
系統故障、重大事件及導致本公司產品或服務可用性中斷之情況，可能損害本公司業務、損害本公司聲譽，並使本公司面臨重大賠償責任。
未能維持本公司信用評級、管理本公司債務及為未來需求籌措額外資金，可能對本公司流動性、資本狀況、借款成本及取得資本市場之能力造成不利影響。
本公司面臨國際營運固有的風險，包括匯率波動，以及地緣政治衝突與中斷可能不利於我們的銷售與營運。
持續的通貨膨脹與相關經濟情勢可能不利於我們的獲利能力、營運結果與現金流。
paragraphs: 本公司之營運及財務表現受多種風險與不確定因素影響。任一上述風險均可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果或前景造成重大不利影響，且對於本年度10-K表報表中所做之預測性陳述之實際結果，可能產生重大不利影響。在此情況下，DXC普通股之交易價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。過往財務表現未必為未來財務表現之可靠指標，歷史趨勢亦不應用以預測未來期間之結果或趨勢。未來財務表現及歷史趨勢可能受本節所討論之風險影響而產生不利影響。其他未被目前知悉或目前預期為不重要之變數及風險與不確定因素，亦可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果或前景，或未來本公司普通股之股價造成重大不利影響。
•若本公司無法有效管理並改善銷售組織，可能難以取得新客戶或增加現有客戶之銷售額。
•本公司可能無法開發並拓展服務方案以應對新興需求與科技趨勢，並維持競爭力。
•本公司提供客戶具有競爭力之服務之能力，取決於本公司吸引並留住合格人員之能力。
•與人工智慧相關之風險，包括本公司對人工智慧技術之採用、部署與治理，可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
•若本公司無法準確預估服務成本及合約完成時間，或本公司或第三方未能履行對客戶之承諾，則本公司合約之獲利能力可能受到不利影響。
